timestamp_verification.method: sha256 match of final edited MP4s against Keynote-Readability-2026-11-07 Media manifest; seek times are chapter_start within each edited clip
timestamp_verification.note: Reading holds are editorial pauses, not measured retry delays. Do not reuse older slide numbers.

checkpoints.title: Customer impact and setup
checkpoints.workflow_state: Before or at Workflow start; synthetic checkout fails with HTTP 500.
evidence: Synthetic trace and service map in source/fixtures/
checkpoints.takeaway: Show the whole agent path first: Trace → Logs → Draft → Review → Save. The public demo reconstructs an incident; it does not resume a production execution.
checkpoints.question: What should survive if a Worker disappears mid-investigation?
checkpoints.continue: Open clip 01 or start offline verify_recording.py / a fresh capture.

checkpoints.title: Lookup fails, then recovers
checkpoints.workflow_state: Gateway log Activity attempt 0 raised HTTP 429; Cadence scheduled attempt 1 after the Workflow retry policy.
checkpoints.takeaway: Keep the 429 readable before showing recovery. Cadence schedules the retry; it did not invent the fault.
checkpoints.question: Which work needs another attempt, and which result is already saved?
checkpoints.continue: Release the presentation hold or watch through gateway-completed.

checkpoints.title: Read the returned evidence
checkpoints.workflow_state: Gateway logs returned after retry. Investigation can continue.
checkpoints.takeaway: The incident error is HTTP 503 upstream. That is separate from the lookup request's HTTP 429.
checkpoints.question: What does the 503 tell the agent to inspect next?
checkpoints.continue: Proceed into model tool choices (checkout, then inventory).
checkpoints.attribution: synthetic log content; Cadence recorded completion

checkpoints.title: Copied lookup is blocked
checkpoints.workflow_state: After two successful agent lookups, capture-only inject_duplicate copied the inventory proposal and blocked dispatch.
evidence: injected_proposal with model_generated false and executed false
checkpoints.takeaway: Application guard code blocked a deliberately copied proposal. Cadence does not automatically identify semantically duplicate tool calls.
checkpoints.question: What should product code own versus what the platform records?
checkpoints.attribution: scripted injection; application guard; Cadence state persistence

checkpoints.title: First diagnosis is incomplete
checkpoints.workflow_state: First draft reports low confidence and leans on inventory without payments or ledger evidence.
evidence: Missing payments and ledger lookups at this point
checkpoints.takeaway: Label confidence as model-reported. Low confidence is not a Cadence signal.
checkpoints.question: Would you approve this draft with the evidence on screen?
checkpoints.continue: Send or watch the revise Signal that asks for ERROR quotations only.

checkpoints.title: Confidence is not new evidence
checkpoints.workflow_state: After revise Signal, reported confidence rises to high while new log lookups remain zero.
evidence: No get-logs scheduled between events 95 and 105
checkpoints.takeaway: Asking the model to quote existing ERRORs can change confidence without gathering new evidence. Keep the new-lookup count visible.
checkpoints.question: What would you require before trusting a confidence jump?
checkpoints.continue: Send guidance toward payments and ledger, or watch clip 04.
checkpoints.attribution: scripted revise Signal; model revision; Cadence Signal delivery

checkpoints.title: Human guidance changes the investigation
checkpoints.workflow_state: Guidance Signal directs a new pass through payments and ledger in the same Run. Final reviewed report keeps root_cause unknown and confidence low.
evidence: Event 141 payments logs including ledger pool exhaustion
Event 186 final report root_cause unknown confidence low
checkpoints.takeaway: After guidance, new logs support connection-pool exhaustion. The initiating trigger remains unknown. Guidance starts new tool work; revision alone does not.
checkpoints.question: What changed in the evidence set after guidance that was missing from the first draft?
checkpoints.continue: Reach the approval wait; do not introduce Reset yet.
checkpoints.attribution: scripted guidance and revise Signals; model and synthetic tools; Cadence same-Run continuation

checkpoints.title: Workers stop at the approval wait
checkpoints.workflow_state: Workflow is open at approval. Capture kills only the two demo Worker PIDs. Cadence service and database stay up.
evidence: Usage at stop equals final Cadence usage (9 responses, 3901/751 tokens)
checkpoints.takeaway: Make the failure boundary explicit: Workers gone, Workflow Run still open, history retained.
checkpoints.question: What must still be true for a replacement Worker to continue without re-calling the model?
checkpoints.continue: Start replacement Workers on the same Task List.
checkpoints.attribution: scripted Worker kill; Cadence service remains

checkpoints.title: Replacement Workers finish the same Run
checkpoints.workflow_state: Replacement Workers restore the approval wait. Approval Signal arrives. Keyed write commits on activities-B. Same Workflow ID and Run ID complete.
checkpoints.takeaway: Recovery adds zero model calls in this interruption because earlier calls completed and their results were recorded. Show the same Workflow ID and Run ID before and after.
checkpoints.question: How does this differ from starting a new Run?
checkpoints.continue: Read the measured comparison table, then discuss Reset separately.
checkpoints.attribution: Cadence replay and Signal delivery; scripted approval; application keyed write

measured_comparison.limits: One controlled comparison with local Qwen2.5:7b, interrupted at approval wait. No external model API charge; compute and infrastructure unpriced. Not dollar savings.

reset.meaning: Reset starts a new Run under the same Workflow ID from a supported boundary. It does not undo external effects.
reset.visual: Ctrl+Z metaphor may appear in the deck; keep that limit explicit.

production_observation.summary: In the observed on-call run, seven log-access calls were denied and nobody authorized access. Those were not seven Cadence Activity retries. The harness returned normally inside its Activity, so the Workflow completed its code path without a diagnosis. A structured wait for human review was missing.
production_observation.public_demo: The public demo reconstructs an incident with synthetic fixtures and carries the investigation forward narratively. It does not resume the production execution.
